solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/distinct-echo-substrings/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1316. Distinct Echo Substrings

Return the number of distinct non-empty substrings of text that can be written as the concatenation of some string with itself (i.e. it can be written as a + a where a is some string).

Example 1:

Input: text = "abcabcabc"
Output: 3
Explanation: The 3 substrings are "abcabc", "bcabca" and "cabcab".

Example 2:

Input: text = "leetcodeleetcode"
Output: 2
Explanation: The 2 substrings are "ee" and "leetcodeleetcode".

Constraints:

    1 <= text.length <= 2000
    text has only lowercase English letters.
"""


class Solution:
    def distinctEchoSubstrings(self, text: str) -> int:
        n = len(text)
        seen = set()
        # For each possible length of substring that is even
        for length in range(2, n + 1, 2):
            half = length // 2
            for start in range(n - length + 1):
                if text[start : start + half] == text[start + half : start + length]:
                    seen.add(text[start : start + length])
        return len(seen)


sol = Solution()

print(sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("abcabcabc"))  # 3

assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("abcabcabc") == 3
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("leetcodeleetcode") == 2

assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("a") == 0
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("aa") == 1
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("aaaa") == 2
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("ababab") == 2
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("abcde") == 0
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz") == 10
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("abcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabcabc") == 13
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("aabbccaabbcc") == 4
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("xyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyzxyz") == 13
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("ab" * 1000) == 999
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("a" * 2000) == 1000
assert sol.distinctEchoSubstrings("abacabadabacaba") == 0
